title: ConnectPlugin
body:
# Simply connect This plugin offers a simple way to connect your Discord and Minecraft server ## Features - Store data - Link accounts - Create custom discord commands ## How to use **1. Invite our Discord bot**
Use the link https://invite.conbot.xyz to invite our ConnectBot to your Discord server **2. Create a token**
Use the `/token create ` command on your Discord server to create a new api token **3. Install this plugin**
Download an install this plugin on your Minecraft server **4. Configure Minecraft plugin**
Insert your api token from step 2 into the configuration file of the plugin
